A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GoRank/GoTrim work and contain readable main text, figures, equations, algorithms, Table 1, and Appendices A–I. Text and visual inspection support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: Sections 3.2 and 4.3 report original experiments on synthetic data and Basel Luftklima temperature measurements. Appendices G–H include additional topology comparisons and asynchronous ranking experiments.

after.justification: V6 retains original experimental rank-error and trimmed-mean results on synthetic and Basel sensor data, including the supplementary experiments.

M1.justification: The GoRank and GoTrim procedures in Algorithms 1–2 are unchanged. Baseline++ and asynchronous GoRank also retain their update rules in Appendices A and H. The revisions concern their theoretical analysis.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same synthetic ranking and contaminated-data tasks, Basel temperature data, and communication-graph families. The asynchronous evaluation scenario already appears in v1.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain Chiuso et al.'s Baseline, Baseline++, ClippedGossip, and the corrupted-mean reference. Appendix H retains the same comparison of asynchronous GoRank, synchronous GoRank, and Baseline++.

E3.justification: The reported error metrics, synthetic sample size, graph parameters, corruption settings, and iteration budgets are unchanged. Appendix G retains the same sensor selection, distance-based graph construction, and tie-breaking preprocessing.

E4.justification: The analyses of rank centrality, graph connectivity, trimming-boundary errors, contamination, and asynchronous behavior are retained. No distinct ablation, robustness test, or case study is introduced or removed.

E5.justification: Both versions report 1,000 trials for Figure 2(a) and means and standard deviations from 100 trials for Figures 2(b–c). No new seed information, uncertainty-reporting practice, or empirical significance procedure appears.

E6.justification: Figure 2(a)'s empirical rank-error points change: v6 replaces v1's differing main-text scatter with the Watts–Strogatz result already present in Figure 4(b). This is a limited replacement of reported values; the central empirical rankings and qualitative conclusions remain stable.

T1.justification: Theorem 2 changes expected absolute rank error from O(1/(ct)) to O(1/sqrt(ct)), supported by a rewritten second-moment argument in Appendix C. Lemma 1 changes its rank-dependent and trimming-boundary factors. Theorem 3 changes GoTrim's rate from O(log(t)/(c^2 t)) to O(1/(c^2 t)), with revised bounds in Appendix D. Theorem 4 and Appendix E replace the finite-time breakdown correction proportional to 1/(t−T) with 1/sqrt(t−T).

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and conclusion strengthen the headline GoTrim convergence claim from O(log(t)/t) to O(1/t). This changes a central theoretical contribution, while the algorithmic novelty and principal empirical claims are retained.

C2.justification: The explanations involving connectivity, rank centrality, trimming-boundary errors, and ClippedGossip's convergence to the corrupted mean remain substantively unchanged. The discussions of missing asynchronous guarantees, multivariate extensions, and difficult L-statistics are also retained.

D1.justification: Both versions provide the same single-CPU/32-GB hardware description, execution-time table, sensor preprocessing details, and supplementary-material code/data access statements.

R1.justification: The 37 referenced works and substantive related-work discussion are unchanged, including the positioning relative to distributed ranking, GoSta, quantile estimation, and ClippedGossip.

P1.justification: Local prose revisions accompany the changed theorems and proofs, with small punctuation, affiliation-formatting, and appendix-heading adjustments. The overall section sequence and most explanatory text remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The same eight figures, one table, and six algorithm blocks remain. Changes include plot rendering, Figure 2(a)'s scatter display, Figure 3(a)'s bound label, and local appendix placement of headings and Algorithm 6. Figure 6 retains the old bound notation.

improvement.justification: Appendix C replaces v1's unjustified control of correlated products through a signed first moment with separate diagonal and time-lagged correlation bounds. This repairs central theoretical support and yields weaker, better-supported rank-error and finite-time robustness guarantees. Appendix D also corrects the weight-increment bound and sharpens the summation supporting GoTrim convergence. These are substantial reliability gains, despite remaining presentation inconsistencies such as Figure 6's obsolete bound label.
